description: ENS resolve: Resolves a .eth name to its address, or an address to its primary .eth name with forward verification, by reading the ENS registry and resolver on Ethereum mainnet. Source: ENS contracts via publicnode. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: direction, name, address, forward_verified (reverse only), resolver.
name: x420_chain_ens
